integrity: No independent validation or independent audit has been performed. All displayed finite checks are reproducible by the standalone program and its recorded output.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary mutual visibility of K_3 Cartesian K_n, n>=3. No extension to other widths or other visibility variants. The orbit group is S_3 x S_n, not asserted to be the full automorphism group in small square cases. Literature-equivalent enumeration in unindexed bipartite C4-saturation research cannot be ruled out. Mathematical proof is self-contained and finite tests only supplement it.
title: Complete visibility and maximality spectra of three-row rook graphs
